subject: E-Commerce
title: Sizing and Standards Chaos
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Sizing and Standards Chaos.

hook.text: A US size 8 shoe is a UK 6, a European 41, and a Japanese 26. Size confusion drives 30% of cross-border returns.

buildup.text: Clothing sizes are even worse. A US medium, Chinese XL, and European 48 can all be the same garment.

discovery.text: Smart sellers provide size conversion charts and AI-powered fit recommendation tools to reduce returns.

twist.text: Vanity sizing makes it worse: brands deliberately use smaller size labels to flatter customers, adding more confusion.

climax.text: Sizing standards remain one of the biggest unsolved problems in cross-border fashion e-commerce.

punchline.text: US 8, UK 6, EU 41, JP 26. Same shoe, four numbers, 30% return rate.

quiz.question: What drives 30% of cross-border fashion returns?
options: Sizing confusion between different international standards
